fields.value: PC Quote, Inc. ("PCQ") and A.B. Watley, Inc. ("ABW"); the amendment also states it applies to their subsidiaries and related companies.

quotes.clauseId: AMENDMENT TO SECTION 2, PART B OF THE CO-BRANDING AGREEMENT
quotes.text:
by and between PC Quote, Inc.
(hereinafter referred to as "PCQ") and A.B. Watley, Inc. (hereinafter
referred to as "ABW")

quotes.clauseId: AMENDMENT TO SECTION 2, PART B OF THE CO-BRANDING AGREEMENT
quotes.text:
This Amendment shall apply to said PCQ
and ABW and all of their subsidiaries and related companies.

ambiguities: The amendment says it applies to "all of their subsidiaries and related companies," but those entities are not named or individually identified.
